cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(bohann_catalog_checks LANGUAGES CXX)
get_filename_component(REPO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../.." ABSOLUTE)

set(POLICY_SOURCES)
foreach(NAME bohann_opening_v1 teammate_shoprouter investment_context_guarded_001_best king_rc4 public_router_v5)
    set(PACKAGE "${REPO_ROOT}/agents/external/${NAME}")
    file(READ "${PACKAGE}/agent.json" MANIFEST)
    string(JSON COUNT LENGTH "${MANIFEST}" sources)
    math(EXPR LAST "${COUNT} - 1")
    foreach(INDEX RANGE ${LAST})
        string(JSON SOURCE GET "${MANIFEST}" sources ${INDEX})
        list(APPEND POLICY_SOURCES "${PACKAGE}/${SOURCE}")
    endforeach()
endforeach()
list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES POLICY_SOURCES)

foreach(TARGET arena pair debug)
    add_executable(${TARGET} arena.cpp investment.cpp king.cpp router.cpp ${POLICY_SOURCES})
    target_compile_features(${TARGET} PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
    target_include_directories(${TARGET} PRIVATE "${REPO_ROOT}")
    target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE -march=native -mtune=native -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti
        -fno-math-errno -fno-semantic-interposition -fno-plt)
    target_link_libraries(${TARGET} PRIVATE pthread)
    if("${TARGET}" STREQUAL "debug")
        target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE -O1 -g -UNDEBUG)
    else()
        target_compile_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE -O3 -DNDEBUG -flto)
        target_link_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE -flto)
    endif()
endforeach()
target_compile_definitions(pair PRIVATE BOHANN_TYPED_PAIR=1)
